editorial:
Imagine waking up every single morning and having absolutely no idea who you are or what you did yesterday. That is the wild situation Pogue finds himself in. He is a private investigator trying to solve a big case, but his brain basically hits a reset button every time he sleeps. You get to follow him as he leaves himself notes and clues just to keep his life together. It is a funny, quirky setup that feels like a puzzle you are solving right along with the main character, and the romance adds a sweet touch to the chaos.

The acting is great and keeps the story moving quickly so you never get bored. While the plot gets a bit messy toward the end, the humor makes up for it. If you love movies where a guy is totally out of his element, you will really enjoy this one. It is a lighthearted ride that does not take itself too seriously.
endingExplained: In the end, you find out that Pogue's memory loss was caused by a head injury from a past accident. As the mystery wraps up, he manages to track down the bad guys and solve the case despite his condition. He finally finds a way to move past his blank slate and starts a real relationship. The movie ends on a happy note with Pogue getting his life and his memory back on track.
targetAudience: Ideal for anyone who loves goofy mysteries and romantic comedies.
